question: A convex mirror has focal length $25\,\text{cm}$. An object is placed $50\,\text{cm}$ in front of it. Find the image distance and magnification.

options.A: Using $f=+25\,\text{cm}$ and $u=-50\,\text{cm}$, $v=-16.7\,\text{cm}$ and $m=-0.33$. The image is real and inverted.
options.B: Using $f=+25\,\text{cm}$ and $u=-50\,\text{cm}$, $v=+25\,\text{cm}$ and $m=+1$. The image is virtual and same size.
options.C:
Using $\frac{1}{v}+\frac{1}{u}=\frac{1}{f}$, $\frac{1}{v}-\frac{1}{50}=\frac{1}{25}$, so $v=\frac{50}{3}\,\text{cm}=16.7\,\text{cm}$.
$m=-\frac{v}{u}=-\frac{16.7}{-50}=+0.33$. The image is virtual, erect and diminished.
options.D: Using $f=+25\,\text{cm}$ and $u=-50\,\text{cm}$, $v=+50\,\text{cm}$ and $m=+2$. The image is virtual and magnified.
